message.content:
Buddhism was founded by **Siddhārtha Gautama**, who became known as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”).  
He was born in the ancient kingdom of Kapilavastu, in the region that is today part of **modern‑day Nepal** (Lumbini). After attaining enlightenment, he taught in the area that is now **Bihar, India** (notably Bodh Gaya). Thus, Buddhism’s origins lie in the subcontinent of **ancient India**, specifically in the territories that now comprise parts of Nepal and northern India.
